integrity: A self-contained analytic proof establishes the claimed continuum statements; a standard-library numerical diagnostic is supplemental. Closely related earlier nonconvexity and zero-split results are explicitly credited. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact complete parameter formula is for the complex quartic two-dimensional coordinate flip with real opposite diagonal entries. For other exponents only sharp small-split and large-split asymptotics are stated, at each fixed exponent other than two. The axial deficit is not the Hausdorff convexification distance; earlier literature proves qualitative nonconvexity.
title: Sharp axial numerical-range gaps for diagonally split coordinate flips on complex \(\ell_p^2\)
